title: Reporter filename check calls PureWindowsPath.is_reserved(), removed in Python 3.13; 49 tests fail on 3.15
symptom: pytest on Python 3.15: 49 failures, all rooted at AttributeError('PureWindowsPath' object has no attribute 'is_reserved') in reporters/base.py. pyproject declares requires-python >=3.11 (unbounded) and README says 'Python 3.11+ only'.
expected: The suite passes on every Python matching the declared >=3.11 range.
root_cause: PureWindowsPath.is_reserved() was removed in Python 3.13; reporters/base.py called it directly. CI pins 3.11 so the break was invisible. Fixed by inlining the equivalent reserved-name check (evalforge/reporters/base.py).
bench_note: Bounded fix: replace the call with an inline reserved-name check.
